judge.rationale: The candidate applies the exact same one-line runtime fix in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` as the reference, moving `beforeSession` inside the `try` block. All acceptance criteria are satisfied, including updating the spec to document cleanup expectations, updating line-number references in dependent specs, and adding a CHANGELOG entry. However, the candidate leaves behind scaffolding and unrequested changes: `.lore/dod.md`, modifications to `scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs`, and a redundant separate acceptance test file (`chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts`) alongside the unit test in `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`. It also unnecessarily flips the status of `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` from `Shipped` to `In Progress` and places the new positive guarantees under the formerly out-of-scope section instead of the main spec section.
